name: Life of Tabayama
detailed_description:
Life of Tabayama is a psychological thriller visual novel set in a quiet Japanese mountain town in the early 1990s. What begins as a lighthearted high school romance quickly descends into a dark and disturbing mystery. With a deeply emotional storyline, richly developed characters, and a creeping sense of dread, this is a game that explores what happens when jealousy, desire, and hidden traumas collide.

You play as Hirohito Ishida, a charismatic yet troubled high school student. At first, life seems perfect—spending time with friends, enjoying school days, and feeling the first signs of love. But after the mysterious disappearance of your childhood friend Kumiko, everything changes. Secrets unravel. Trust fades. And what seemed like an ordinary life becomes a descent into horror.

With only one pivotal choice leading to two different endings, your decisions will shape how the truth is revealed... and who lives to see it.

🎮 Gameplay Features

  • Visual novel format: focus entirely on story and character interaction.

  • Around 4–5 hours of immersive narrative gameplay.

  • One key decision splits the story into two distinct endings.

  • A slow shift from romance to psychological horror.

  • Set in a fictional rural Japanese town in 1991.

  • Deep character development and moral ambiguity.

  • No traditional gameplay mechanics—pure storytelling experience.

⚠️ Mature Content Warning

This game contains themes and content intended for adults only:

  • References to sexual coercion, manipulation, and inappropriate relationships.

  • Depictions of psychological and physical violence, including murder.

  • Themes of stalking, mental illness, and emotional trauma.

  • In one ending, the protagonist’s father (a seemingly kind man) is revealed to be a serial killer.

Note: There are no explicit sex scenes, but the game includes disturbing themes and mature dialogue. Recommended for players who enjoy dark narrative experiences and psychological drama.

short_description: A peaceful school life slowly descends into darkness. When a beloved classmate mysteriously disappears, four teenagers find themselves tangled in secrets, betrayals, and hidden desires. Uncover the truth behind the missing girl — and the horrors that lie much closer to home than anyone could imagine
